## Summary
<sup>What this changes and why. No need to recap CI-verifiable facts (test counts, lint status, "build passes")... CI reports those itself.</sup>

## Behavior changes
<sup>List every user-visible behavior that differs after this PR. "None" is a claim reviewers will check. Refactors that change any observable behavior must say so here.</sup>

## Hot paths
<sup>Does this add I/O, network, DB access, or blocking work to a launch, frame, or sync path? Which, and why is that acceptable?</sup>

## Testing evidence
<sup>Hardware used, the flow you drove, and what you observed. Screenshots welcome where UI is involved.</sup>

## AI assistance
<sup>What role did AI play, and to what extent? (e.g. "written primarily by Claude Code", "consulted for design, authored manually", "none")</sup>

## Checklist
<sup>Please check all that apply.</sup>

- [ ] I've tested the changes on real hardware
- [ ] I've added or updated unit tests covering the changes
- [ ] I've personally reviewed and understand the code being submitted
